name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: The Microsoft 365 outage that began on 12 Nov was still running past 20 hours on 13 Nov, hitting email and Intune
state: The Microsoft 365 disruption that took down Exchange Online email and Intune for organisations worldwide on 12 Nov was still unresolved on 13 Nov, stretching past 20 hours as fixes failed (The Register, 12–13 Nov). That puts a major cloud outage of more than 2 hours inside the past 48 hours. No effect on payments, airlines or emergency services was reported, so this is Watch, not Alert.
for_you: Organisations relying on Microsoft 365 email and device management have been exposed; Microsoft's service health status page carries official updates on recovery.
rubric_hit: Major cloud outage > 2h in past 48h: Microsoft 365 outage 20h+ on 12–13 Nov = Watch

sources.title: The Register — Microsoft's massive M365 outage stretches past 20 hours as its fixes keep failing
The Register — Microsoft struggling to fix massive cloud outage that's taken down email and Intune

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
